The recorded build succeeded and #print axioms closure is exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Lean.ofReduceBool, Lean.trustCompiler, Quot.sound]. Thus the proof depends transitively on compiled reduction: native_decide is absent from the target declaration’s own text but occurs in supporting lemmas on which it depends, so declaration-local textual inspection cannot disclose the full trust base whereas the kernel closure does. This establishes a source-native trust disclosure for these exact bytes, not falsehood, concealment, scientific rejection, or a universal rule that compiled reduction is unacceptable. The repository root and linked src/v4.24.0 subtree expose no licence file, while other version subtrees do; this is only a bounded absence observation and establishes neither repository-wide absence nor permission or prohibition to reuse, modify, or contribute. The proof owner’s trust policy, contribution/licence direction, and complete statement fidelity remain unresolved.
